html:
Hezbollah, the Party of God, is a Shia Islamist party and armed force in Lebanon. It arose in 1982, when Iran's Revolutionary Guards organised Shia fighters in the Bekaa valley against the Israeli invasion.

Lebanon's Shia were long the poorest community, in the south and the Bekaa. Hezbollah ran schools, hospitals and welfare, and fought Israel's occupation of the south until Israel withdrew in 2000. Kept armed after the Taif Agreement, it became stronger than the Lebanese army and a power in government, close to Syria and Iran.

It fought Israel again in the 2006 war and sent fighters to save Assad in the Syrian civil war. In 2024 Israel killed its leader Hassan Nasrallah and much of its command. See also Shia Islam.
sum: Hezbollah, the Party of God, is a Shia Islamist party and armed force in Lebanon. It arose in 1982, when Iran's Revolutionary Guards organised Shia fighters in the Bekaa valley against the Israeli invasion.
